# SegmentedControl

A switch between a few options. The white pill slides to the selected one in 133ms. Native radios underneath, so arrow keys work.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/segmentedcontrol)

## Usage

```tsx
<SegmentedControl
  name="delivery"
  label="Delivery method"
  value={delivery}
  onChange={setDelivery}
  options={[
    { value: 'ship', label: 'Ship', icon: <TruckIcon /> },
    { value: 'pickup', label: 'Pick up', icon: <StoreIcon /> },
  ]}
/>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | Shared name of the radios. |
| `value / onChange` | `string / (value, index) => void` | The selected option. |
| `options` | `{ value, label, icon? }[]` | Two in the checkout; any small number works. |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name of the group. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `SegmentedControl.module.css`
- `SegmentedControl.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
